## Type of change
Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the **~99% Native Bash** style guidelines of this project. *(No heavy dependencies like Python or Ruby for example)*
- [ ] I have performed a self review of my code.
- [ ] I have properly commented my code, particularly in hard to understand areas such as hex math or `awk` parsing sections.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation *(such as updating the README with a new flag for example)*
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally using `sudo ./hextcp.sh` to ensure no `fi` statements or loops were broken in the process.
